h1: Attic Insulation Removal in San Leandro, CA
description: Attic insulation removal in San Leandro, CA: vacuum out old, damp or rodent-damaged insulation and clean the deck before reinsulating. Get a free inspection.
intro: We vacuum old, damp or rodent-damaged insulation out of the attic, sanitize the surfaces, and hand you a clean space ready for new insulation. Free inspection, fixed written estimate.
hero_alt: Vacuum hose removing old insulation from an attic floor

sections.h2: When attic insulation has to come out
paragraphs: Attic insulation gets removed when it has been wet, pressed flat, or turned into a rodent nest. Topping up over damaged material buries the problem, so the removal is what makes the reinsulation worth doing.

Rodents tunnel through attic insulation and leave droppings throughout it. We vacuum out every trace, sanitize the affected surfaces, and coordinate sealing the entry points so the new insulation does not become the next nest.

A truck-mounted vacuum runs a long hose from the street up to the attic, so the old material is pulled straight into bags at the truck and never passes through your living space. Floors are covered along the hose path.
bullets: Truck-mounted vacuum, hose to the attic
Bags hauled away the same day

paragraphs: We quote removal and reinsulation as one sequence: vacuum, sanitize, seal, then blow in the new material to the R-value your attic needs. Doing both in one visit means the attic is never left exposed between jobs.
bullets: One crew, one visit where possible
New material installed only after the space is clean

paragraphs: The crew lays protection along the path, runs the hose, and works until the attic floor is down to bare deck. We show you the empty attic before anything new goes in, so you see exactly what was removed.
bullets: Bare deck by end of day on most attics

faqs.q: How much does attic insulation removal cost?
faqs.a: It follows the attic size, the depth of the material and how contaminated it is. The inspection gives you a fixed written estimate, usually quoted together with the reinsulation that follows.

faqs.q: Do I need to remove old attic insulation?
faqs.a: Only if it is damp, moldy, rodent-damaged or pressed flat. Healthy material can often be topped up instead, which we will confirm during the inspection.

faqs.q: How long does attic removal take?
faqs.a: Most attics are vacuumed out in one day. Deep material, heavy contamination or tough access can run into a second day, and the estimate will say so.

faqs.q: What if there are rodents in the attic insulation?
faqs.a: That is a common reason for removal. We vacuum out the contaminated material, sanitize, and seal the entry points before any new insulation goes in.

faqs.q: Can you reinsulate the same day?
faqs.a: Often yes. Once the attic is empty and sanitized, sealing and new blown-in insulation can follow in the same visit, so the attic is not left open between jobs.

faqs.q: What happens to the old insulation?
faqs.a: It is bagged at the truck and hauled away the same day. Nothing is left in the attic or around the house.
